content.text: Image point coordinates are in [y, x] format, where y is the vertical axis, x is the horizontal axis; their values are normalized from 0 to 1000, where [0 0] is the top left, [1000 1000] is the bottom right. What object is located to the right of point [779 998] in the second image, just outside of the frame? Choices: A. water bottle. B. coffee maker. C. stairs. D. laundry rack. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
